description: Show the live state of the stack: its stacks, resources, their ingress URLs and container ports, the stack-level ports, and Tilt readiness (data.tilt.readiness: ready, pending, failures, enabled; null when no Tilt answers). A project of local-process (`command`) services reports no tilt block: readiness is data.readiness and each service's url is its localhost address. Read-only. Poll it after `up`; after a failed `up` call it first with unhealthy: true to see only the broken services (data.resources and each stack's resources then hold only those; data.unhealthy names them and data.filteredTo says it was trimmed). For the services a project defines whether or not they run use `resource_list`; for URLs only use `network_list`; for host checks use `doctor`. Optionally select the project with projectPath. CLI equivalent: `flisk status --json`.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the Flisk project root; run this operation from that directory.

stack.description: Only report the services in this stack

unhealthy.description: Only the services that are failing or still starting. The first call after a failed `up`; with every service healthy it returns an empty list, not an error.

name: status
